Holly Taylor

Democratic candidate for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 9, Texas

Criminal defense and appellate attorney; former Travis County prosecutor

Holly Taylor is an Austin criminal defense and appellate attorney who was a prosecutor in the Travis County District Attorney's Office for more than 17 years and a staff attorney at the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals. She is the Democratic nominee for the open Place 9 seat, which Judge David Newell is leaving at retirement. In the Nov. 3, 2026 general election she faces Republican John Messinger. She also ran for the Court of Criminal Appeals in 2024, for Presiding Judge.

Where Taylor stands

Wrongful convictions
Says the justice system has flaws that must be fixed. Supports addressing the root causes of wrongful convictions, citing her Conviction Integrity Unit work that led to exonerations in cases her office had prosecuted.
Judicial independence
Says she wants to bring an independent voice to the court and keep it free of political influence.
Judicial philosophy
Says cases before the court should get a fair, impartial, and thorough review rooted in the Constitution, the rule of law, science, and facts.
Treatment of parties before the court
Says everyone before the court, including defendants, survivors, and families, should be treated with dignity and humanity.
Court rules and training
Says she wants the rules of evidence to work as they should. Notes the court administers training grants and says she could help shape how legal professionals learn about the flaws that lead to wrongful convictions.

Background

  • Democratic nominee, Texas Court of Criminal Appeals Place 9 (2026)
  • Candidate, Texas Court of Criminal Appeals Presiding Judge (2024)
  • Criminal defense attorney (current)
  • Rules Attorney and staff attorney, Texas Court of Criminal Appeals; current member of the court's Rules Advisory Committee
  • Adjunct professor, University of Texas School of Law
  • Board certified in criminal appellate law, Texas Board of Legal Specialization
  • Master's degree in Public Affairs
